item.title: Carney lands in Australia ahead of planned speech to Australian parliament
item.description: SYDNEY — Prime Minister Mark Carney has landed in Australia, where he is seeking more collaboration in trade and defence. The prime minister arrived in Sydney midday Tuesday in Australia, or Monday evening in Canada.

item.title: Submarine companies make their final pitches to Canada as it rushes to choose a fleet
item.description: OTTAWA — The competition to build the Canadian navy's next fleet of submarines is heading into a new phase after a deadline for both finalists to submit their final proposals to the federal government on Monday.

item.title: There's no PBO: Ottawa fails to appoint new fiscal watchdog as interim term expires
item.description: OTTAWA — There is currently no parliamentary budget officer scrutinizing federal finances in Ottawa as the interim fiscal watchdog's term expired Monday without a successor in place.

item.title: New study finds sharp rise in young men contacting Ontario gambling helpline
item.description: The rate of young men contacting Ontario’s mental health helpline for gambling-related problems has increased by more than 300 per cent after the province allowed private online gambling, a new study suggests
